name: Superfluid IDA forged callAgreement context
summary: Superfluid agreements decoded the ctx bytes from caller-shaped call data without checking the host's ctx stamp. Through Host.callAgreement the attacker passed a forged context naming victims as msgSender, created and updated IDA indexes as those accounts, distributed their super-token balances to itself and downgraded them.
notes: Last pre-exploit CodeUpdated on the IDA proxy activated implementation 0x07711bb6dfbc99a1df1f2d7f57545a67519941e7, whose inlined AgreementLibrary.authorizeTokenAccess accepts an unstamped ctx; it stayed active until the fix upgrade at block 24695087.

Victim super-token depletion measured by the attacker's downgrades in source-2 across 24 victim (token, account) pairs. Illiquid tokens whose disposal moved the market (QI, MOCA, SDT, STACK) and sdam3CRV use realised proceeds; USDC.e at par; WETH and MATIC at DefiLlama quotes. The aggregate combines bases, hence method other. The theft completed in source-2 at 1644301024; realizedAt is the last attacker disposal used for the realised-proceeds valuation (second MOCA sale, block 24766896).
